applicabilityBasis.summary: NUSD is described as a DeFi-composable synthetic dollar backed by yield-bearing crypto assets and hedged strategies rather than cash, and Neutrl materials describe the token as a claim on strategy yield rather than a fixed-value payment claim. U.S. persons are also excluded from the reviewed service terms.

genius.notes: NUSD is treated as an explicit GENIUS exclusion because the reviewed materials describe a synthetic, strategy-backed DeFi asset rather than an issuer-obligated fixed-value payment stablecoin; this is not a finding about general U.S. legality. The current Terms identify Caverna Auctus Inc. in Panama, while the RWA profile leaves issuer domicile blank; the issuer/token relationship should be re-checked. The dedicated Accountable dashboard was linked as the public reserve/solvency disclosure. No GENIUS authorization posture is applicable.
